chunks: Yahya ibn Abi al-‘Ala’ narrated from Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If a slave kills a free man, then the family of the one killed has the choice: if they wish, they may kill him, and if they wish, they may enslave him.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْمَقْتُولِ: The family or legal heirs of the slain person who hold the right of choice.
key_terms.اسْتَعْبَدُوا: They may enslave him; a legal option mentioned for the victim’s family.
key_terms.الْحُرَّ: A free person; here, the victim who was killed.
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: A slave; here, the perpetrator in the legal case.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave kills a free man in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning retaliation and legal recourse when a slave kills a free man. It states that the heirs of the murdered person may choose either execution of the killer or taking him into enslavement.
